properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 30 at 8:47PM MST until August 30 at 10:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:

rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have

highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Santa Rosa Wash, Quijotoa Wash, Hickiwan Wash, San Simon Wash,

deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 30 at 5:25PM MST until August 30 at 10:15PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 525 PM MST /625 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain
earlier over southwest Utah including the Paria River and Buckskin
Gulch resulted in between 0.50 and 1.00 inches of rainfall. A river
gage along the Paria River just north of the Arizona/Utah border
indicated a 2 foot rise. In addition, flow from Buckskin Gulch will
contribute to flash flooding along the Paria River. As a Result,
flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Paria River.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Paria Canyon, Paria River Slot Canyon, Vermilion Cliffs National
Monument and Lees Ferry.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River and Paria River.
properties.instruction:
Get out of the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters will flow down
the Paria River, reaching the confluence with the Colorado River at
Lees Ferry around Midnight.

properties.areaDesc: Crawford, IL; Lawrence, IL; Knox, IN; Sullivan, IN
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 30 at 8:42PM CDT until August 31 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following river in Indiana...
Illinois...

Wabash River at Riverton

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River at Riverton. The river
has crested. Flooding is expected come to an end on the Wabash by
Monday morning.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Riverton.

* WHEN...Until Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 16.0 feet, Some agricultural lands underwater.  A few
rural roads in Crawford County, Illinois close as water backs up
Minnow Slough.  High water affects campground at Leaverton Park in
Palestine.  A few private roads near the Gill Township levee in
Sullivan County may flood.  Water level is at the top of most
makeshift levees.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:00 PM CDT /9:00 PM EDT/ Sunday the stage was 15.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage just
after midnight tonight and continue falling to 4.7 feet
Wednesday, September 09.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued Monday afternoon at 100 PM CDT /200
PM EDT/.
